name: 揉纸持握变形
title: 揉纸持握变形
description: 把一张图片变成可以揉的纸：按住时纸面沿预计算的折痕路径（随机导向线 + Verlet 约束求解，同一 seed 结果可复现）塌陷成带棱线的 3D 纸团，可拖着走并带速度倾斜；松手按三种行为收场——弹回平整、保留折痕记忆、或停在揉皱态。three.js WebGL 渲染双面材质与纸纹凹凸，自带软投影、键盘操作（空格按持、方向键移动、Esc 复位）、加载失败回退为普通图片。
cardDescription: 按住把图片揉成 3D 纸团，松手弹回或留下折痕。

api.name: src
api.description: 印在纸面上的图片地址，需要允许跨域加载；缺失或加载失败回退为普通图片并触发 onError

api.name: alt
api.description: 回退图片的 alt，也是可聚焦按钮 aria-label 的开头

api.name: backSrc
api.description: 纸背面的图片地址；留空显示 paperColor

api.name: width
api.description: 纸面原始宽度（px）

api.name: height
api.description: 纸面原始高度（px）

api.name: sceneHeight
api.description: 根容器高度（px）

api.name: imageFit
api.description: 图片铺进纸面的方式

api.name: releaseBehavior
api.description: 松手后的行为：弹回平整、保留折痕记忆、或停在揉皱状态

api.name: crumpleAmount
api.description: 按住时揉皱的深度 0–1，对应预计算折痕路径的进度

api.name: crumpleDuration
api.description: 按住时揉皱弹簧的时长（秒）

api.name: releaseDuration
api.description: 松手后各弹簧的时长（秒）

api.name: foldCount
api.description: 折痕导向线数量，钳制在 3–16

api.name: foldSharpness
api.description: 棱线锐利度 0–1，影响铰链刚度与法线混合

api.name: wrinkleDepth
api.description: 纸面压缩强度 0–2

api.name: creaseStrength
api.description: creased 松手时保留峰值褶皱的比例 0–1

api.name: paperColor
api.description: 无 backSrc 时纸背面的颜色

api.name: roughness
api.description: 材质粗糙度 0–1

api.name: paperTexture
api.description: 纸纹凹凸强度 0–1

api.name: lightIntensity
api.description: 方向光强度

api.name: lightAngle
api.description: 光源方位角（度）

api.name: shadow
api.description: 是否渲染柔和投影

api.name: shadowOpacity
api.description: 投影浓度 0–1

api.name: draggable
api.description: 允许按住拖动纸团

api.name: dragRotation
api.description: 速度倾斜的最大角度（度），钳制 0–60

api.name: dragRadius
api.description: 纸团离中心的最远距离（px）

api.name: returnToOrigin
api.description: 松手后回正，而不是顺速度滑走

api.name: rotation
api.description: 纸面常驻旋转角（度）

api.name: seed
api.description: 随机种子：顶点抖动、三角形翻边与折痕导向都由它决定

api.name: detail
api.description: 网格精度，内部折算并钳制到 8–24 段

api.name: disabled
api.description: 禁用交互并中止当前按持

api.name: resetKey
api.description: 改动此值会把纸面重置为平整

api.name: onStateChange
api.description: 交互状态回调

api.name: onError
api.description: 加载或 WebGL 失败时回调

api.name: className
api.description: 根元素附加类名

api.name: style
api.description: 根元素内联样式

prompt:
Implement the "PaperCrumple" component from zero: a framed image you press and hold with a pointer or the keyboard, and while you hold, it physically crumples into a textured 3D sheet of folds; you can drag the crumpled sheet around with velocity tilt, and on release it either springs back flat, keeps a creased memory of the fold, or stays crumpled. Rendering is WebGL via a 3D engine dependency (three), simulation is a precomputed Verlet fold path; it must not depend on external pages, videos or off-the-shelf effect components. The image itself is the only external asset (CORS-enabled URL); pixel-perfect artwork is defined by the caller's image, not this spec. ## Structure & rendering - Two files: PaperCrumple.jsx (entry, fold-path solver, scene, interaction) and PaperCrumple.css (layout, fallback, hit target). Runtime dependency: three (WebGL renderer, materials, math). React >= 18. - Root is a `
` (plus caller className), position relative, width 100%, height = sceneHeight px (inline style), overflow hidden, isolated stacking. Inline CSS variables `--pc-image-width/--pc-image-height` track the paper's fitted on-screen size. - Children: a full-bleed WebGL `` (absolute, pointer-events none, visible only when status is ready, optionally carrying a CSS drop-shadow filter matching shadowOpacity); while not ready, a plain `` showing src, absolutely centered with translate(-50%,-50%) and the rotation prop applied, object-fit from imageFit, sized by the CSS variables; a transparent `
